subject.title: 🐛 Feishu channel fails with tenant_access_token error when HTTP proxy is configured

question: Should Feishu SDK REST/token and WebSocket bootstrap HTTP follow the ambient and managed proxy routing contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86386, or should Feishu remain direct-by-default until a per-channel proxy policy exists?
rationale: The code path carries app credentials, tenant tokens, and message delivery over network egress, and the correct proxy boundary is an operator/security policy choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept PR 86386 Egress Contract
options.body: Feishu SDK HTTP follows ambient proxy agents and managed proxy override semantics now, while broader direct/proxy mode work stays tracked separately.

options.title: Narrow To Managed Proxy Only
options.body: Only force the operator-managed proxy path and leave ordinary ambient proxy inheritance or direct routing for a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Pause For Per-Channel Policy
options.body: Defer this issue until maintainers choose an explicit Feishu channel proxy mode that covers direct, ambient, and managed proxy deployments.

recommendation.title: Accept PR 86386 Egress Contract
recommendation.body: Feishu SDK HTTP follows ambient proxy agents and managed proxy override semantics now, while broader direct/proxy mode work stays tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the shared ambient proxy helper path and is the best available routing owner for the proxy/security boundary decision.
